headline: “Saving is more profitable in eggs”: Iran raises gasoline prices amid economic crisis
summary: Iran is raising gasoline prices again amid a deepening economic crisis. Reuters reports a sharp fall in oil exports and foreign currency income, while The Guardian reports rising food prices and rial depreciation.
why: Iran's fuel pricing and oil export revenue are central to its public finances, currency stability and domestic inflation.
